title: The Twelve Aeons Reproduced in the Spiritual Man
description: The Twelve Great Aeons of Light are reproduced as members within the spiritual man: five faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) joined with the Calling and the Hearing make seven, indwelt by the Living Spirit and centered on the Ambassador. The same structure that articulates the heavens articulates the regenerate human, so the spiritual man holds the spiritual senses as members within him exactly as the Aeons stand within the Father's fullness.
